newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-SEEDS ADVANCE AT HALL OF FAME CHAMPIONSHIPS MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SEEDS ADVANCE AT HALL OF FAME CHAMPIONSHIPS MONDAY.

text.p: Fourth seed Sandon Stolle of Australia, fifth seed Sargis Sargsian of Armenia and eighth seed Brett Steven of New Zealand posted straight-set victories Monday at the $255,000 Hall of Fame Tennis Championships.

Stolle beat American Steve Campbell 6-2 6-2, Sargsian got past Canadian Daniel Nestor 7-6 (7-3) 7-5 and Steven disposed of Mexican qualifier Luis Herrera 6-3 6-2. Seventh seed Leander Paes of India needed three sets to eliminate Fernan Wibier of the Netherlands 7-5 6-7 (4-7) 6-4.
Alex Radulescu of Germany and Australian Mark Woodforde are the top seeds at this event.

Radulescu, ranked 83rd in the world, reached the third round at Wimbledon, where he lost to Woodforde's doubles partner, Todd Woodbridge. He reached the final of April's Gold Flake Open in India, his first career final as a professional. Radulescu will take on American Vince Spadea in the first round on Tuesday.

Woodforde teamed with Woodbridge to win their fifth consecutive Wimbledon doubles title on Sunday, only the second team to accomplish that feat. In singles, Woodforde reached the fourth round, where he fell to the Michael Stich. Woodforde, ranked 53rd in the world, will meet American Steve Bryan Tuesday.
